text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I became Sasami Anshinzawa's 
acupuncture test dummy, I've grown
accustomed to playing along with her
whims. On one such
day...
Come... Come hither...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt! Wrong deity! This is Sasami Anshinzawa, divine acupuncturist, at your service! ☆
choice_data_list: Are the Three Goddesses calling to...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, you've been in a slump and
haven't made
much progress lately,
right?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
So I thought I'd give you a nice little
poke using
some extra extraordinary
needles! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, <username>!
Don't be
a spoilsport! ♪
choice_data_list: A super-potent one?! Th-that's a b...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'll open up a world of new possibilities,
just for
you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Annnd POKE! (Poke... poke... poke...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment the needle pricks me, a
flood of
unfamiliar faces and voices
infiltrates my mind!

text_block_list.name: Founder of Acupuncture
text_block_list.text:
Behold, acupuncture! The power that
will save all
of Umamusume-kind!

text_block_list.name: Unnamed Acupuncturist A
text_block_list.text:
One day, I hope to give all Umamusume
a life
free from worries!

text_block_list.name: Unnamed Acupuncturist B
text_block_list.text:
What incredible running! I wish to give
them the
poke they need to achieve
their dreams!

text_block_list.name: Unnamed Acupuncturist C
text_block_list.text:
To pave the way for their futures with

acupuncture... That is our one and only
wish...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel the weight of many wishes and
desires being
entrusted to me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A fire burns within my chest... and an

uncontainable power bursts from me!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: What the?! Where are you going?!

text_block_list.name: Partner Running Umam...
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Is that <chrname>'s
trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Partner Running Umam...
text_block_list.text:
Holy smokes, what insane speed! I can't
keep up!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Fascinating! To think he can match
Umamusume
in speed! This is beyond my
wildest dreams!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Fascinating! To think she can match
Umamusume
in speed! This is beyond my
wildest dreams!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Could Trainer also secretly be an
Umamusu—no,
surely not...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hooray! ♪ Did all of you see the results
of my
acupuncture skills?! Wow! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, I go partner running with

<chrname> to my heart's
content!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Sasami Anshinzawa was true to
her word
and really did open up a world
of new
possibilities for me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day following that wondrous,
one-off
moment...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That poke really did the trick, didn't it?
I could barely tell you apart from an
actual Umamusume
from the way you
ran!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's wrong? You look like
you've seen
much better days.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear! I guess the greater the results,
the
greater the side effects...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
But don't you worry! As long as you
keep up your training, I'm sure you'll
eventually be able to
handle the speed
boost without repercussions!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although her words raise alarm bells in
every fiber
of my being...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the event that we really do achieve
that possibility someday, I would love to
run alongside
<chrname>
once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the event that we really do achieve
that possibility someday, I would love to
run alongside
<chrname>
once more.
